name: Krea AI homepage — dark generative-media app landing by krea.ai
description: A dark, app-style landing page where a permanent left sidebar (pinned white Sign-in pill, grouped tool list with colourful mini-icons) frames a starfield hero whose centrepiece is a conversational prompt bar rather than a traditional CTA. Below, the rhythm changes section by section: a full-width announcement banner, a dense bento of small feature tiles beside one large promo card, horizontally scrolled template and video-model cards with Featured/New pills and credit costs, then a quiet centred model gallery with search and tabs, and finally a dense multi-column sitemap footer. Hierarchy is carried by a few large light display headlines set against otherwise 12–13px utilitarian text, hairline borders and #141414 panels, with a single blue accent reserved for primary actions while media thumbnails supply the colour.
